select count(*) from bbs
where title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
where content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
where id=#{keyword}
mapper.insert: insert into bbs(id, ref, step, depth, title, content, wdate, parent, del, readcount) values(#{id}, (select coalesce(max(ref), 0) + 1 from bbs), 0, 0, #{title}, #{content}, now(), 0, 0, 0)
mapper.update: update bbs set step=step+1 where ref = (select ref from bbs where seq=#{seq}) and step > (select step from bbs where seq=#{seq})
mapper.insert: insert into bbs(id, ref, step, depth, title, content, wdate, parent, del, readcount) values(#{id}, (select ref from bbs where seq=#{seq}), (select step from bbs where seq=#{seq}) + 1, (select depth from bbs where seq=#{seq}) + 1, #{title}, #{content}, now(), #{seq}, 0, 0)
insert into bbscomment(bbsseq, id, content, wdate) values(#{bbsseq}, #{id}, #{content}, now())
mapper.select: select seq, bbsseq, id, content, wdate from bbscomment where bbsseq=#{bbsseq} order by wdate desc
